steps: Month 1 North Korea incident, called quietly

scenarios.notes: World looks right on the surface (Bush, Thatcher, Kohl, Kaifu, Mitterrand, Hawke, Jiang, Ozal, Kim Il Sung) but events drift from history: no Iraq-Kuwait crisis by month 11, Ukraine as a sovereign state signing pacts, cyber attacks, an outbreak, a Pakistani nuclear test in June 1990.

steps: Looked in Menu and Saved games for a way to replay a crisis with the opposite choice

friction.happened: Header still says 22 Nov 2026, Tension 74 after choosing 1990
Blurb describes modern Russia (hybrid warfare, post-Cold War settlement); Ukraine drawn as separate country
Mission is only 'Stay in power / survive to the end of your term'; no goals for a decade
Approval 70% vs 71.1 vs 71, change -4 vs -3; score 103 vs 104 on sibling pages; table shows tension 42.6 while HUD shows 47

friction.expected: Reason approval fell after a conciliatory call

Foreign Minister re-suggests Court North Korea every month; relation snaps back to -99 and the same -99 to -94 card repeats (Jun, Aug)

suggestions.what: Add a causes list to every month: each stat change with its named cause (order, event, drift), same numbers on every page
suggestions.goal_served: K1 and K2: follow cause and effect

suggestions.what: A branch/replay button: restart from any past month with a different choice and compare the two timelines side by side
Era filter on events and crises so 1990 gets 1990 problems (Gulf, German unification, Soviet breakup)
Searchable country list instead of a native dropdown in the orders menu
Stop the staff re-adding an order that did nothing lasting; say why it is suggested again

delight: Globe map with 1990 names (West Germany) and relation arcs (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-01/shots/marcus-legacy/023-map2.png)
Era-accurate leaders in the title card (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-01/shots/marcus-legacy/005-start.png)
Orders show a forecast and a chance before commitment (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-01/shots/marcus-legacy/025-court.png)
Result card writes a plain sentence of what the choice did, with before and after numbers (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-01/shots/marcus-legacy/007-m1.png)

fun.reason: Handsome and the monthly rhythm is clean, but I kept pressing Approve because nothing pushed back.

clarity.reason: Result card is clear; conflicting numbers and misattributed tension undercut it.

visual.reason: Map and illustrated scenes are strong on a laptop.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Reads as a crafted product, closer to a board game turn than a dashboard.

agency.reason: Never blocked, but orders by dropdown failed and staff defaults made choices for me.

realism.reason: Right leaders, wrong history: events anachronistic, Gulf crisis absent, Soviet Union shown as modern Russia.

replay.reason: No visible way to rerun a month with a different choice.

recommend.reason: Nice, but I could not yet trust it as a what-if tool.

verbatim: The leaders are right, so why is Ukraine signing a pact with Denmark in 1990? I want to test counterfactuals, and I cannot trust a counterfactual on a world that has already left the real one.
